fields.acceptance: Beside run-abandon-unmerged.txtar (no upstream, branch kept), a testscript pushes cs/<slug> to a bare origin with an upstream set, adds a local commit never pushed, abandons the run and asserts 'delete-branch kept: it has commits merged into neither its upstream nor HEAD' and that git log cs/<slug> still shows the commit
fields.statement: rhiza run abandon keeps the run's local cs/<slug> branch when it holds commits merged into neither its upstream nor HEAD, reporting delete-branch kept with that reason, whether or not the branch has an upstream
